leader_area.skill_text_raw:
[auto] When this card attacks, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 red ≪Earthling≫ card to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[br]
[awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, or you have 2 or more energy and {Jaguar's Island, Challenge Stage} in play: Draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
